thread.title: Apple Leads Dow As Bulls Make Another Stand; Cisco Systems Also Strong

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Apple Leads Dow As Bulls Make Another Stand; Cisco Systems Also Strong
text:
But gains for the major stock indexes faded Monday morning, but it didn't take long for buyers to back as indexes were near session highs in afternoon trading.
X The   average led the way, up 1.7%. The Nasdaq composite and S&P 500 picked up about 1.3%. Small caps lagged badly early in the session but picked up the pace, with the Russell 2000 up 0.7%.
Volume on the both exchanges was tracking well below Friday's levels. On the NYSE, advancing stocks outnumbered decliners by more than 2-to-1.
The S&P 500 fell below the 200-day moving average Friday but found support, rallying 1.5% in higher volume. The NYSE composite and Russell 2000 showed similar action. The strong price action came after a robust rally Tuesday in higher volume.
Gold miners and oil stocks outperformed. Steel stocks also fared well as President Trump's infrastructure plans came into more focus.
The 10-year Treasury yield edged up 1 basis point to 2.86%, while U.S. crude oil futures added just over 1% to $59.88 a barrel.
Big gainers in the Dow included Apple ( AAPL ), Boeing ( BA ), American Express ( AXP ) and Cisco Systems ( CSCO ), with gains of around 3%. Cisco's earnings report is due Wednesday after the close. It's holding support nicely above the 50-day moving average .
In the stock market today , General Dynamics ( GD ) slipped 0.1% on news it's buying IT defense firm CSRA ( CSRA ) for $9.8 billion, including debt. Shares of CSRA surged 31% to 40.40.
Inside the IBD 50 , Adobe Systems ( ADBE ) picked up nearly 2%. On a weekly chart, Adobe Systems is trading near the 10-week moving average, a key support level, but Adobe hasn't made a convincing bounce off the line in heavy volume yet.
Also in the IBD 50, China Lodging ( HTHT ) had a good day, up 6% to 142.25. It gapped above the 50-day line after a failed breakout from a late-stage base with a 142.90 buy point. It may be tempting to buy back, but keep in mind the stock has been a huge winner already.
China-based Vipshop ( VIPS ) is holding up well before its earnings report after the close. Shares were up 4% to 16.02 ahead of the results.
Results from China names Sina ( SINA ), Weibo ( WB )and Baidu ( BIDU )are due Tuesday. Shares of former IBD Leaderboard name Weibo ( WB ) added nearly 2% to 117.37 as it trades near the 50-day line.
